label: hh.ru
terms_note: Open API (OAuth; vacancies search + negotiations); no client yet — assisted browser applies with the resume.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (full candidate-side API: search, details, apply, negotiations, messages, resumes).
auth: 1. Register the application at dev.hh.ru (requires an hh.ru account) → `client_id`, `client_secret`.

2. OAuth 2.0 authorization code: `https://hh.ru/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=…&redirect_uri=…` → `POST https://api.hh.ru/token` (grant_type authorization_code) → `access_token`, `refresh_token`; refresh via the same token URL. Client-credentials tokens exist for application-level cal
3. Anonymous methods (vacancy search, vacancy view, dictionaries, suggests) need no token.

endpoints.notes: text, search_field, experience, employment, schedule, area, metro, professional_role, industry, employer_id, currency, salary, only_with_salary, period, date_from, date_to, order_by, per_page, page, excluded_text, work_format, education, part_time, accept_temporary, premium, responses_count_enabled,

id, first_name, last_name, email, is_applicant, resumes_url

endpoints.purpose: apply to a vacancy with a resume
endpoints.notes: vacancy_id, resume_id, message (cover letter); errors limit_exceeded (daily response limit), captcha_required, test required
form field `message`; overall_limit (403) when the message limit is exceeded

reference.limits: Not numerically published. Documented error families: `limit_exceeded` (negotiations — daily response limit), `overall_limit` (messages), `captcha_required` (403), `view_limit_exceeded` (employer resume views, 429). - Developer agreement (dev.hh.ru/admin/developer_agreement): the developer registers the app with their own hh.ru account; §1.4 — an app used by job seekers must show, at its own sign-up, a checkbox confirming acceptance of hh.ru's job-seeker service agreement (offer) and let the user read it on screen; HeadHunter may refuse / revoke API keys for misuse (spam, political agitation,
mcp_sdk: Official docs repository: https://github.com/hhru/api (no official SDK; community wrappers exist on PyPI / npm, unverified).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: client_id of an application registered at https://dev.hh.ru/admin; used to obtain an application token (grant_type=client_credentials at https://api.hh.ru/token).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: client_secret of the same hh.ru application.

config_fields.name: user_agent
config_fields.help: Your application name and developer contact e-mail, e.g. 'MyApp/1.0 (me@example.com)'. hh.ru requires a User-Agent (or HH-User-Agent) naming the application and the developer's contact address ('Указание в заголовке названия приложения и контактной почты разработчика'); it is appended to the server's User-Agent.

adapter.rate_note: No numeric rate limit is published in the OpenAPI description. Two requests per second.

me.note: GET /me with the application token answers the application profile (auth_type 'application').

search.note: GET /vacancies (Поиск по вакансиям): text supports the hh.ru query language, page is 0-based (sent as page-1), per_page ≤ 100, and page×per_page may not exceed 2000 ('глубина возвращаемых результатов не может быть больше 2000'). The docs warn that without an authorization token a captcha is requested after the first call, so the server sends an application token. Region filters take area ids from /areas, so location/country are not sent. description is the search snippet (responsibility, may contain <highlighttext>); salary is salary.from/to in salary.currency (the gross flag stays in raw).

not_offered.apply: Applying (POST /negotiations) needs an applicant's user token from the authorization-code flow plus a resume_id; this server authenticates as the application (client credentials), which cannot act for a job seeker.
not_offered.list_messages: Negotiation messages belong to an applicant or employer user token (authorization-code flow); the application token used here has no user.

evidence: host api.hh.ru: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.hh.ru/openapi/specification/public: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
